title: The Hottest Fitness Trends of 2024 You Should Know About
author: Grhics Tech
description: As the fitness industry evolves, staying informed about the latest trends can help you make the most of your workouts and maintain a healthy lifestyle. In 2024, several emerging trends are
content:
As the fitness industry evolves, staying informed about the latest trends can help you make the most of your workouts and maintain a healthy lifestyle.
In 2024, several emerging trends are gaining popularity, offering fresh approaches to fitness. From cutting-edge supplements to innovative workout routines, these trends are designed to enhance your performance, boost your health, and keep you motivated.
Let's explore the hottest fitness trends of 2024 that you should be aware of.
1. Peptides
Peptides are gaining popularity in the fitness community for their potential to boost muscle growth, speed recovery, and support overall health. They are short chains of amino acids that play an essential role in hormone production and immune system regulation.
In recent years, specific peptides have gained attention for their ability to promote muscle growth and fat loss, making them a valuable tool for those looking to optimize their fitness results.
One peptide that has garnered significant attention is sermorelin. It is an artificially created peptide that triggers the release of growth hormone from the pituitary gland.
By promoting the natural production of growth hormone, sermorelin can aid in muscle development, increase energy levels, and improve recovery times after intense workouts.
This makes it appealing to athletes and fitness enthusiasts aiming to optimize their performance and reach their fitness goals.
If you're interested in exploring the benefits of Sermorelin, it's essential to consult with a healthcare professional before starting any new supplement regimen. Additionally, it's crucial to source it from a reputable provider, as quality can vary.
You might even find Sermorelin peptide for sale from trusted suppliers such as Sports Technology Labs, which specializes in high-quality products.
However, remember that this peptide should be used responsibly and in conjunction with a balanced diet and regular exercise.
2. High-Intensity Interval Training (HIIT)
High intensity interval Training (or HIIT) will continue to dominate the fitness scene in 2024. This workout technique involves alternating between brief bursts of intense exercise and short periods of rest or low-intensity activity.
HIIT is renowned for its effectiveness in burning calories, improving cardiovascular health, and building endurance in a relatively short amount of time. It's an excellent option for those with busy schedules who want to maximize their workout efficiency.
One of the key advantages of HIIT is its ability to keep your metabolism high after you've finished exercising. This post-exercise calorie burn, known as the 'afterburn effect,' can contribute to weight loss and fat reduction. HIIT workouts can be adapted to various fitness levels, making them accessible to beginners and challenging for advanced athletes alike.
In 2024, HIIT is being incorporated into various fitness programs, from traditional gym settings to outdoor boot camps and online classes. Its versatility allows it to be tailored to different preferences and goals, whether you're aiming for strength building, fat loss, or improved cardiovascular fitness.
Additionally, the ever-growing popularity of wearable fitness technology means that tracking your HIIT progress has never been easier, helping you stay motivated and on track.
3. Personal Training
Personal training remains a staple in the fitness industry, and its importance is only growing in 2024. With the increasing complexity of fitness goals and the need for tailored workout plans, personal trainers are becoming essential for those looking to achieve specific results.
Whether you're new to fitness or a seasoned athlete , working with a personal trainer can provide the guidance and support needed to reach your objectives efficiently and safely.
In 2024, personal training is more accessible than ever, thanks to the rise of online training platforms. These platforms allow clients to connect with trainers from around the world, receiving customized workout plans and one-on-one coaching remotely.
This flexibility is particularly beneficial for individuals with tight schedules or those who prefer to work out at home. Online personal training can include live video sessions, pre-recorded workouts, and even virtual reality experiences that simulate gym environments.
Furthermore, personal trainers in 2024 are increasingly focusing on holistic health approaches. This means that they design workout routines and offer guidance on nutrition, mental well-being, and lifestyle choices.
By addressing all aspects of health, personal trainers are helping clients achieve long-lasting results and improve their overall quality of life.
4. Yoga
Yoga continues to be a popular fitness trend, with its benefits extending far beyond physical flexibility. In 2024, yoga is evolving to include more diverse styles and practices, catering to a broader range of participants.
Whether you prefer traditional yoga forms like Hatha or Vinyasa or modern variations like power yoga or aerial yoga, there's a practice to fit your needs.
The mental health benefits of yoga are increasingly recognized, making it a vital part of a balanced fitness routine. Yoga helps reduce stress, improve focus, and enhance mental clarity, which are all essential for maintaining overall well-being.
In 2024, more fitness enthusiasts are turning to yoga as a way to manage the stresses of daily life while staying physically active.
Additionally, the accessibility of yoga has expanded with the proliferation of online classes and virtual studios. This allows practitioners to engage in their favorite yoga sessions from the comfort of their homes, making it easier to incorporate yoga into their daily routines.
As yoga continues to grow in popularity, it's becoming a cornerstone of fitness, appealing to people of all ages and fitness levels.
5. Posture Workouts
In 2024, posture workouts are becoming more popular as awareness grows about the impact of poor posture on health. With the rise of sedentary lifestyles and the increased use of electronic devices, many individuals are experiencing issues related to posture, such as back pain, neck strain, and reduced mobility.
Posture workouts aim to address these issues by strengthening the muscles that support proper alignment and improving body awareness.
These workouts typically focus on exercises that target the core, back, and shoulder muscles, helping to correct imbalances and promote better posture. In addition to physical benefits, improving posture can lead to increased confidence and a more positive self-image.
Good posture is also associated with better breathing and circulation, which can enhance overall health and well-being.
In 2024, posture workouts are being integrated into various fitness programs, from yoga classes to strength training routines. Fitness professionals emphasize the importance of maintaining good posture during all types of exercises, ensuring that clients perform movements safely and effectively. As awareness of the benefits of proper posture grows, these workouts are becoming a crucial component of comprehensive fitness plans.
By staying informed about the hottest fitness trends of 2024, you can make informed decisions about your fitness journey. Whether you're interested in peptides, high-intensity interval training, personal training, yoga, or posture workouts, these trends offer valuable tools and techniques to help you achieve your health and fitness goals.
As always, it's essential to approach these trends with a balanced perspective, incorporating them into a well-rounded fitness routine that supports your overall well-being.

title: LJHS baseball: The only woman to play baseball in CIF sounds off
description: Malaika Underwood, the only woman to play baseball in the CIF San Diego Section, returned to the La Jolla High campus where she reigned as the section's Female Athlete of the Year in 1999 for her Viking Baseball Hall of Fame induction.
content:
Malaika Underwood, the only woman to play baseball in the CIF San Diego Section, returned to the La Jolla High campus where she reigned as the section's Female Athlete of the Year in 1999 for her Viking Baseball Hall of Fame induction. And she didn't mince words about getting other women to play the sport.
'Ultimately… I think we've got to get away from this social construct that 'girls play softball and boys play baseball,'' said the former second baseman, who is on the staff of the U.S. Baseball women's national team, 'because there's no reason that girls can't play baseball.
'It's a wonderful game, and they (girls) should have as much opportunity to play as boys do.'
That's a different message from a more general: 'Let's support girls and women in women's sports, to build up those sports as women participate more and more,' that someone might expect from the Hall of Fame inductee. Malaika Underwood delivers the ceremonial first pitch at the La Jolla-Mira Mesa baseball game with her daughter Birdie holding her bouquet and smiling alongside her. Underwood, the only woman to ever play baseball in the CIF San Diego Section, was inducted into the Viking Baseball Hall of Fame. PHOTO BY ED PIPER
By the way, in her golden senior year at La Jolla High in 1998-1999, the lithe Underwood, who looked as ready to play sports as she did back as a prep player as she threw out the ceremonial first ball to her nephew, Danny Underwood, a senior outfielder on the Mira Mesa baseball team, Malaika (pronounced mah-LAY-kah) starred for the Viking girls volleyball team, her main sport, as well as for the Viking girls basketball team. She was named All-CIF in both of those sports.
Underwood brought along her oldest daughter, Birdie, from their home near Jacksonville, Fla., on her visit to La Jolla for the festivities. She feels strongly about that, too: 'It's nice to be here,' she said in a separate interview, 'and to have my family (including her nephew on the Marauders) here and have my oldest daughter be able to see it, be a part of it, and to know that hard work can result in achievement, as well.'
Danny Underwood, by the way, had an outstanding senior year for head coach Mike Bovee's team, hitting .346 as the Marauders' starting centerfielder and leading the squad in stolen bases with 22 in 24 attempts.
Malaika, after her days on the La Jolla campus, went on to the University of North Carolina on a volleyball scholarship to play for the Tar Heels. She earned her bachelor's degree in international studies and a master's in sports administration. She went back to playing baseball in 2006 and helped win four gold medals for the U.S. women's national team in the baseball World Cup.
She presently holds the national team record for most hits, runs, RBIs, and stolen bases. She has played in more games for Team USA than anyone else in history, female or male.
In 2015, Underwood was named the USA Baseball Sportswoman of the Year. The UNC website notes she was a 5 feet 9 inches tall outside hitter in volleyball for the Tar Heels who helped lead UNC to three straight ACC championships and the NCAA tournament four years in a row.

title: Caryn Blanton receives Woman of the Year honor for homeless work
author: Dave
description: Caryn Blanton, executive director of Shoreline Community Services in Pacific Beach, was honored with a state proclamation at The Compass Station on Aug. 22.
content:
Caryn Blanton, executive director of Shoreline Community Services in Pacific Beach, was honored with a state proclamation at The Compass Station on Aug. 22.
'Caryn Blanton has the distinguished honor of being the 2024 Woman of the Year for Assembly District 77,' said Assemblymember Tasha Boerner's senior field representative, Andres Geurts-Barreto at the homelessness services center. 'Caryn has done amazing work here in the community.'
Added Geurts-Barreto: 'I'd like to thank you personally for being a wonderful community member and being a bedrock of this community. I've been in PB for 34 years now. I grew up here and saw this area change. I've seen the hard work that's been done here and would just like to present this resolution on behalf of the Assembly of the State of California.' Caryn Blanton, executive director of Shoreline Community Services in Pacific Beach, received a plaque on Aug. 22 from Andres Geurts-Barreto, field representative for District 77 Assemblymember Tasha Boerner. Blanton was named Woman of the Year for her stewardship of the two-year-old Compass Station, a program of SCS offering resources and services to unsheltered coastal neighbors. CONTRIBUTED PHOTO
'The only words that I have to say is, 'This doesn't happen by one person doing it,'' said Blanton adding, 'The one thing I've learned in all of my leadership, and all of the years that I've been doing this kind of work, is that you have to surround yourself by really good people. I have an amazing staff and amazing volunteers. I have all of you (unsheltered neighbors) partake in our services, and service providers that make sure that you get what you need.'
PB-based Shoreline Community Services works to match up unsheltered individuals with wrap-around services provided at The Compass Station, a drop-in resource center at 1004 Chalcedony St. 'Our vision at Shoreline is to create an interdependent neighborhood with one common goal: a safe and thriving neighborhood for everyone,' said Blanton, who's worked for 20-plus years in community development, mostly with marginalized populations including 10 years with Pacific Beach's homeless. 'We focus on making sure that the most vulnerable among us, right now the homeless, are taken care of with great compassion and equity.'
The Compass Station, an all-purpose resource center for the unhoused offering numerous services under one roof, is a collaboration between nonprofit Shoreline Community Services and two Pacific Beach churches – Christ Lutheran Church, and St. Andrew's By-the-Sea. It was officially dedicated at 1004 Chalcedony St. in April 2022.

title: Eight Compelling Reasons for RNs to Pursue a BSN Degree ASAP
author: Grhics Tech
description: Nursing is a noble profession driven by a commitment to patient care, empath
content:
Nursing is a noble profession driven by a commitment to patient care, empathy, and continuous learning. Registered Nurses (RNs) are often the backbone of healthcare settings, providing essential services that ensure patient recovery and well-being. However, the healthcare field is rapidly evolving, with new technologies, treatments, and patient care models emerging. To keep pace with these changes, RNs must continually update their skills and knowledge. Pursuing a Bachelor of Science in Nursing, for instance, is increasingly becoming essential for RNs to stay competitive and effective in their roles.
This article explores eight compelling reasons why RNs should consider advancing their education to a BSN level as soon as possible.
1. Enhanced Career Opportunities
Perhaps the most intriguing reason to pursue a BSN degree is the various career opportunities that are open afterward for registered nurses (RNs). While an RN diploma or associate degree may suffice for entry-level positions, a BSN is increasingly required for more advanced roles. Many healthcare facilities prefer or mandate a BSN for specialized positions, such as critical care, pediatrics, or geriatrics. Furthermore, nurses with a BSN are better positioned for leadership roles, including charge nurse or nurse manager. The degree provides a comprehensive education that covers not only clinical skills but also leadership, research, and public health. Ultimately, a BSN opens doors to roles that are not available to those with only an RN diploma, ensuring a more dynamic and fulfilling career path.
2. Convenience of Online Learning
One of the most compelling reasons for RNs to pursue a BSN now is the convenience offered by online learning. The demanding schedules of working nurses often make traditional, in-person classes impractical. However, RN to BSN online programs have revolutionized continuing education by providing a flexible, accessible format that fits into the busy lives of healthcare professionals. Online programs allow nurses to study at their own pace and on their own schedule, which means they can balance their work, personal life, and education more effectively. Online learning also eliminates the need for commuting, saving time and reducing stress. This flexibility enables nurses to continue working full-time while advancing their education, making it possible to achieve a BSN without sacrificing career momentum or income.
3. Improved Patient Care Quality
Earning a BSN is not just about career advancement; it also directly impacts the quality of care provided to patients. Research consistently shows that nurses with a BSN are better prepared to handle complex patient care situations and are associated with better patient outcomes. A BSN program offers in-depth training in critical thinking, evidence-based practice, and patient management, equipping nurses with the skills needed to make more informed decisions in clinical settings. Furthermore, BSN-prepared nurses are trained to consider a holistic approach to patient care, addressing immediate medical needs as well as the broader social, cultural, and psychological factors affecting health. This comprehensive training enhances patient safety, reduces medical errors, and improves overall healthcare delivery.
4. Preparation for Leadership Roles
A BSN provides the foundation for nurses to take on leadership roles within healthcare settings. Unlike an RN diploma or associate degree, a BSN includes coursework in management, healthcare policy, and organizational behavior, which are essential for supervisory and administrative positions. Nurses with a BSN are better equipped to lead teams, manage resources, and implement changes in healthcare practices. These skills are critical in today's fast-paced healthcare environment, where effective leadership is essential for improving patient care and operational efficiency.
5. Greater Job Security
As the healthcare industry continues to evolve, many employers are setting higher educational standards for their nursing staff. A BSN is increasingly becoming the minimum requirement for employment in many hospitals and healthcare facilities. This trend is partly due to the growing body of evidence suggesting that BSN-prepared nurses are associated with better patient outcomes. As a result, nurses with only an RN diploma or associate degree may find themselves at a disadvantage in the job market. By obtaining a BSN, nurses not only enhance their skills and knowledge but also secure their positions in an increasingly competitive field.
6. Access to Advanced Specializations
Nurses interested in fields such as oncology, pediatrics, critical care, or trauma nursing often need a BSN to qualify for specialized training programs or certifications. The comprehensive education provided by a BSN program equips nurses with the theoretical knowledge and clinical experience necessary to excel in these specialized areas. Moreover, specialization can lead to more fulfilling and challenging career opportunities, allowing nurses to focus on areas they are passionate about. The ability to specialize contributes to a nurse's professional development and increases their value to employers, further expanding career prospects.
7. Alignment with Future Healthcare Trends
The healthcare industry is shifting towards a more holistic and patient-centered approach, emphasizing preventive care, population health, and chronic disease management. A BSN curriculum typically includes training in these areas, preparing nurses to meet the demands of modern healthcare delivery. As healthcare systems adopt new models of care, such as accountable care organizations (ACOs) and patient-centered medical homes (PCMHs), the need for nurses who can navigate these changes and provide comprehensive care is growing. BSN-prepared nurses are well-positioned to thrive in these environments , as their education equips them with a broader understanding of healthcare systems, policy, and evidence-based practice. This alignment with future trends ensures that BSN-prepared nurses remain relevant and valuable in a rapidly changing field.
8. Foundation for Further Education
For nurses considering further education, such as a Master of Science in Nursing (MSN) or a Doctor of Nursing Practice (DNP), a BSN is often a prerequisite. Advanced degrees open doors to a wide range of career opportunities, including roles in advanced clinical practice, education, research, and healthcare administration. By obtaining a BSN now, RNs lay the groundwork for future educational pursuits and professional growth. A BSN provides the academic foundation needed for graduate studies and simultaneously enhances a nurse's critical thinking, leadership, and research skills—key competencies for advanced nursing roles.
As evident from this article, pursuing a BSN offers Registered Nurses several advantages, from greater job security and access to specialized roles to alignment with future healthcare trends and a solid foundation for further education. With the growing emphasis on higher education and quality patient care, obtaining a BSN is a strategic move for any RN looking to advance their career and make a meaningful impact in the field of nursing. The benefits are clear, and the time to act is now—pursuing a BSN is an investment in both personal and professional growth, ensuring a brighter and more secure future in nursing.

title: Howl-O-Scream unleashes new scare zones at SeaWorld San Diego
description: Howl-O-Scream at SeaWorld San Diego returns Sept. 27 and running on select nights through Nov. 2. Howl-O-Scream is the only event in town offering a full night of fear with haunts, spine-tingling thrills, shows, coasters, speakeasies, food and more.
content:
Howl-O-Scream at SeaWorld San Diego returns Sept. 27 and running on select nights through Nov. 2. Howl-O-Scream is the only event in town offering a full night of fear with haunts, spine-tingling thrills, shows, coasters, speakeasies, food and more.
SeaWorld has elevated every single element of Howl-O-Scream for 2024, creating an experience of eerie entertainment, hair-raising shows, and a variety of delectably daring food and drink options. Around every corner, in every nook and cranny, are all-new and enhanced scares and scenes that even the bravest souls will be unsettled by the night's horrors.
HAUNTED HOUSES
Guests can venture into the darkness, navigating shadowy tunnels and flickering corridors, where every step reveals chilling secrets. In Circus of the Damned, clowns with groundbreaking 3-D effects will fill rooms with frightful laughs. Nightmare Experiment plunges visitors into the grim world of a sadistic doctor and his horrifying medical ordeals. Simon's Slaughterhouse exposes the gruesome secrets of a meat factory, while Deathwater Bayou immerses guests in a haunting bayou of dark rituals and voodoo magic. Finally, Area 64: Alien Outbreak presents a nightmarish scene of extraterrestrial terror, with sinister experiments and eerie alien horrors at every turn.
SCARE ZONES
Throughout the event, guests can brace themselves for unexpected adrenaline-pumping experiences when walking upon any of the seven uniquely themed scare zones. The event is introducing four brand-new zones, from creatures that emerge from beneath the surface to eerie moonlit thrills, toys that spring to life and give you chills, and clowns that make you cry from frightful laughter, the scare zones promise to deliver heart-pounding scares and unforgettable thrills.
Terrors of the Deep – At the water's edge, deadly sea beasts and eldritch horrors emerge from the depths to terrorize the poor fishermen who call the docks home.
Ripper Row –The infamous murderer Jack The Ripper is terrorizing the streets of Ripper Row. Everyone is on edge, distrustful, and more than willing to accost strangers if it means staying alive.
Red Moon Revelry – A once quiet commune deep in the woods has been transformed into a bloodthirsty vampire cabal, celebrating the blood moon's arrival. A feast is upon all who are drawn in by the sounds of a party.
All Hallows Harvest – An abandoned farmland where nothing can be protected from the cursed scarecrows intent on harvesting bodies and souls to feed their dark desires.
Haunting the park pathways for another year are favorite scare zones fans love to hate, including creepy dolls and sinister stuffed animals at Deadly Toys, mystifying, undead evils rise at The Graveyard and disgruntled, deranged carnies at Carnival of Chaos.
LIVE ENTERTAINMENT
Among the haunted houses and scare zones, visitors will encounter Vile Vignettes – staged scenes designed to terrify unsuspecting visitors. This year, Howl-O-Scream is introducing three new vignettes, each featuring a leading character and a spine-chilling tale that will haunt you long after the night ends.
Fall Of Atlantis – A scholar shunned for their pursuit of the arcane and mystical stumbles across a mysterious artifact at a dig site that promises to unlock the secrets of Atlantis and uncover why the ancient city fell to ruin.
Hunter's Oath – A vampire hunter at the forest's edge gathers supporters to take on the mysterious Red Moon Revelers. Will you choose to join him in his battle against the gathering dark forces, or will you fall victim?
Songs Of Old Halloween – Gather 'round and hear the tales of Halloween long since forgotten to all but the darkest of shadows. But beware, nary a tale you hear ends well, and legend says that the stories themselves wish to be forgotten.
Returning for a year of suspense and horror is Misfortune, where brave guests enter a fortune teller's tent to hear ominous predictions of woe and anguish; Dark Magic, a sadistic magician's twisted untraditional magic show; and Call from Beyond, where a mad scientist conducts dangerous experiments in his private lab, pushing the boundaries of fear and science.
ROCK AND STOMP
Guests looking for an entertaining break from haunted houses, scare zones and frights in their night, can take a seat for a new theatrical performance, Monster Stomp! In the misty corners of Victorian-era London, a fiend known only as Jack the Ripper walks the streets. Watch him take the stage in a way never seen before in this modern rock and rhythm spectacular. Guests will hold onto their seats as electrifying percussion, dancing and singing combine for a show that's as darkly entertaining as it is exhilarating.
This event will have more announcements to come on more entertainment, new themed food and bars, hidden speakeasies, plus more. Intended for a mature audience, Howl-O-Scream is a separately ticketed event. For more information and to purchase tickets, visit https://seaworld.com/san-diego/events/howl-o-scream/.

title: How to File a Personal Injury Claim: A Step-by-Step Guide
author: Grhics Tech
description: Personal injuries can turn lives upside down, and navigating the aftermath of such inci
content:
Personal injuries can turn lives upside down, and navigating the aftermath of such incidents can be incredibly overwhelming. Whether it's a car accident, a slip and fall, or another unfortunate event, the process of filing a personal injury claim is crucial for seeking compensation and justice. In Bakersfield, California, a city known for its vibrant agricultural industry and growing community, residents face unique challenges when dealing with personal injury cases. Those who require help with such incidents can get in touch with an experienced and reputed law firm like Kuzyk Law for comprehensive guidance.
As Bakersfield continues to expand and develop, incidents that lead to personal injuries, from workplace accidents to traffic collisions, are an inevitable part of daily life. The bustling streets and diverse environments in Bakersfield mean that those who suffer from personal injuries must not only manage their recovery but also navigate a complex legal landscape to ensure their rights are protected. This guide will walk you through the essential steps to file a personal injury claim, providing clarity and direction during a challenging time. By understanding these steps, you can better manage the legal aspects of your situation, allowing you to focus on your health and well-being while pursuing the compensation you deserve. Step 1: Seek Medical Attention
The first and most crucial step in filing a personal injury claim is seeking immediate medical attention. Your health should always take priority over legal matters. Seeking prompt medical care not only ensures your well-being but also establishes a record of the injuries sustained, which will be crucial for your claim. Step 2: Document the Incident
In order to strengthen your case, it's important to gather as much evidence as possible. Start by documenting the incident itself. Take clear photos of any visible injuries, property damage, hazardous conditions, or relevant factors that caused the accident. Additionally, any official reports or documents detailing the incident should be collected. Step 3: Collect Contact Information
Gathering contact information from everyone involved in the accident is essential for your personal injury claim. Obtain names, phone numbers, addresses, email addresses, insurance information, and other relevant details from all parties involved – including witnesses – if possible. Step 4: Notify the Relevant Parties
Once you've sought medical attention and gathered sufficient evidence and contact information, it's time to notify the appropriate parties about your intention to file a personal injury claim. This usually involves contacting the negligent party's insurance company or legal representation and providing them with relevant details about who you are and how they can reach you. Step 5: Consult an Experienced Personal Injury Lawyer
While it's certainly possible to handle some personal injury claims independently, it's highly recommended that you consult with an experienced personal injury lawyer early in the process. An attorney can guide you through the complexities of the legal system, ensure that your rights are protected, and work to maximize the compensation you are entitled to. Step 6: File a Personal Injury Lawsuit
If attempts at negotiation and settlement prove unsuccessful, it may become necessary to file a personal injury lawsuit. Your lawyer will assist you in drafting the complaint that outlines your allegations against the responsible party. They will also ensure that all necessary documents, fees, and forms are submitted within the designated time frame. Step 7: The Discovery Phase
Following the filing of your personal injury lawsuit, both parties will enter into a phase called discovery . During this phase, relevant information is exchanged between both sides through interrogatories (written questions), document production requests, and depositions (where parties involved or witnesses answer questions under oath). Step 8: Negotiate Settlement or Proceed with Trial
Based on the evidence presented during discovery and negotiations with opposing counsel, your lawyer will help craft an appropriate settlement demand for compensation. This demand letter usually includes medical expenses, lost wages due to injury, the pain and suffering endured as a result of the accident, and any future damages predicted by medical professionals. Should negotiations fail to yield a satisfactory resolution, proceeding to trial becomes an option. Conclusion:
Filing a personal injury claim requires careful attention to detail and adherence to specific legal procedures. By following these steps – seeking medical attention quickly, documenting all evidence, collecting contact information, notifying relevant parties, consulting with an attorney, potentially filing a lawsuit, engaging in discovery, negotiating settlements, or proceeding to trial – victims can navigate through this challenging process with confidence. Remember that each case is unique, and seeking guidance from a qualified personal injury lawyer at every step offers the best chance for success in securing the compensation you rightfully deserve.

title: Letter to the editor re: Hillcrest celebrates updated community plan
description: In response to '
content:
In response to 'Hillcrest celebrates updated community plan.'
I don't think I have ever sent a note to the author of a newspaper article before. But because of the importance of this issue to the Uptown community, including Hillcrest and Mission Hills, I am taking a few moments to reach out, and I thank you for taking the time to read this.
My overall comment on your story is that it is biased and does not present the full picture. Perhaps that's what you intended, in which case I would say you accomplished your goal. But if you, as a publisher, feel that your responsibility is to truly inform your readership, then I would say you fell quite short.
While I could give extensive examples of the City's deeply flawed and dishonest approach to shoving this plan through to its conclusion, let me just, for the sake of brevity, focus on a few significant shortcomings, as follows:
1. The LGBTQ corridor/cultural district is in reality a slick way to permit the demolition of buildings which are historic from an LGBTQ perspective. Basically, an important LGBTQ structure can be demolished so long as some sort of plaque is placed on the site, describing what used to be there and what previously happened there. That is a weak substitute for the real thing, akin to demolishing Monticello and instead installed a plaque which says 'Thomas Jefferson lived here.' So, in my view, you are skewing this sellout of the LGBTQ community with some sort of implied 'win,' which is a pyrrhic victory at best.
2. The Community Group Uptown Planners conducted many, many, many meetings over the years, and submitted detailed itemizations of problems with the plan, with questions and/or recommended changes to City Planners. The recommendations made by Uptown Planners were largely ignored. I attended many of these meetings, with City Staff sometimes present, and it was all basically Kabuki Theater; City Staff 'checking the box' that they attended so that the City could claim inclusiveness, when in fact the die had already been cast. Your article was quick to mention all of the meetings that the City attended, but you didn't complete your reporting properly by noting how few of the community's recommendations were in fact adopted.
3. The most egregious part of this entire debacle, was the overturning of an election. As you know, Uptown Planners are democratically elected by the community. But as a thorn in Mayor Gloria's side, a bogus DEI theory was used to cancel the results of this election, in order for the Mayor to install essentially his own group of true believers as the community voice. A simple check would reveal that in fact the elected Uptown Planners group is more diverse than the new group which has been formed. I would think your readership would like to know about undemocratic political shenanigans, and the rigging of the deck to arrive at a selected outcome.
I suspect you achieved your goal with the article, and as publisher, you are in a position to do so. But I do think your readers deserved a more balanced view of this most-important story.
Ken Perilli, Mission Hills

title: Can you buy happiness?
author: Lcsw . With Over Years
description: Whether you're a Buddhist monk or a TikTok star, age 90 or 19, drowning in money or barely getting by: isn't happiness what we all want? Happiness is a word that has many meanings, here are some synonyms that sure sounded good to me: Contentment Joy Delight Gladness Pleasure Who…
content:
Whether you're a Buddhist monk or a TikTok star, age 90 or 19, drowning in money or barely getting by: isn't happiness what we all want?
Happiness is a word that has many meanings, here are some synonyms that sure sounded good to me: Contentment
Joy
Delight
Gladness
Pleasure
Who doesn't want that? So, how do you get it? Can you buy it? If so, where do you get it and how much will it cost? If you can't buy it, what are your alternatives?
Many of us happiness-seekers have a challenge with delayed gratification, especially when social media shouts at us, 'Get it now, don't wait, only an idiot would be patient.' To me, as a psychotherapist, it feels like we're leaving our hearts and minds behind as we focus on accumulating as much cool stuff as we can as soon as we can. This leads to getting sucked into a whirlpool of spending, temporary satisfaction, and – ultimately – depression that leads to more spending and eventual debt.
Debt does not equal happiness, can we agree on that?
We all want to be happy and being a good consumer looks like an easy path to get there. Really good advertising – and there's a lot of it around these days – manipulates our emotions. As a result, it's no surprise that many of us feel we're not living up to our (earning/achieving/sexual) potential and are cosmic losers.
But, hey, this isn't an either/or situation: we can enjoy nice things, just don't make them the most important things in your life. If you have money and beautiful objects, great! But if you don't, can you be okay with that too? Or will it suck you down into depression?
Let's ratchet up the consumerism dial and ask another question: Are we people or are we brands ? I recently read how a young gay San Diegan had decided to turn himself into a brand so he could become wealthy and popular. This is not the way to happiness. If it worked, the Kardashians would be up there with the Dalai Lama and Mother Teresa.
According to this young writer, 'typically younger gay males 17-21 use skills they've yet to learn in marketing 101 and turn themselves into a product, complete with brand recognition… Branding one's self (sic) is the new way to claim a piece of fame in our local bar and club scene.'
This could be amusing if it weren't so sad: Do we want a piece of fame so badly that we're willing to commodify ourselves to get it? So much for having personality, intelligence and social skills. Am I just an old fart who wonders why integrity, honesty and patience don't matter anymore? Maybe so.
Being a big-time consumer and turning yourself into a brand may get you some good stuff, but it usually brings anxiety and depression, not happiness. Author Patricia Pearson, in her book, 'A Brief History of Anxiety (Yours and Mine)' found that 28.8% of Americans will suffer anxiety in their lifetime – the highest level in the world – and that $4.2 Billion is spent annually, in the USA alone, on treating anxiety.
As a psychotherapist, I see a relationship between the crazy anxiety epidemic in this country and the out-of-control consumerism that so many of us get sucked into. As a therapist, I typically see several people a month who want to find a way out of the low self-esteem that comes from thinking you're nothing but your brand, your house, your clothes or your stuff.
As someone who has a comfortable home, nice car and enjoys clothes, music and eating out, I am not recommending that you give up the basic comforts you've worked so hard for. What I am putting out for your consideration, however, is the idea that you cannot buy happiness, you can only buy things, and the happiness that comes from things is temporary . Even if you become as popular a 'brand' as Apple or Amazon: happiness, peace of mind, friendship and a wonderful lover do not come with the package. Those joys typically come to us another way: through patience, humility, honesty, kindness and empathy to others.

title: Valley Twirlers Square Dance Club starts classes for new dancers Sept. 17
description: Tired of sitting home with nothing to do? Try square dancing. Groups of eight people form 'squares' while doing a series of moves 'called' by a square dance caller to a variety of toe-tapping music.…
content:
Tired of sitting home with nothing to do? Try square dancing.
Groups of eight people form 'squares' while doing a series of moves 'called' by a square dance caller to a variety of toe-tapping music. The dancers never know what move will be called next, adding to the mental challenge. Easy to learn, once you've got the basics, you can dance at any square dance club in San Diego–or around the world.
Why square dance?
1. Social Aspects – Square Dancing is a great way to meet people in a non-threatening, relaxed social atmosphere. It is suitable for ages eight to adult.
2. Healthy Environment – Square Dance clubs are smoke and alcohol free.
3. Cardiovascular Fitness – Dancing is a safe way to exercise. The level of exertion is up to each participant. You can rev it up for a high intensity workout or take it easy for a relaxing, yet beneficial workout. Dancing regularly can lead to a slower heart rate, lower blood pressure, and an improved cholesterol profile.
4. Body & Brain Boost – Square dancers react to 'calls' as they are given, forcing the body and brain to be tightly coordinated. A number of the steps in a call are memorized, which keeps the brain sharp.
5. Get Your Steps In – The President's Council on Physical Fitness and Sports recommends 10,000 steps per day to maintain physical fitness. It is estimated that a typical square dancer can expect to clock 9,000 to 10,000 steps per dance.
6. Sturdy Bones – The side-to-side movements of dancing strengthen weight-bearing bones and help prevent the slow loss of bone mass. Dancing keeps joints moving, improves balance, and is nice alternative to jogging or other high-intensity activities.
7. Mental Health – Square dancing's social aspect is an antidote for loneliness and depression; it allows dancers to interact with others–you can't square dance without taking somone's hand! Studies have shown that activities involving both physical and mental activity help slow the onset of Alzheimer's disease.
8. It's Fun! – With moves like Slip the Clutch, Ferris Wheel, and Load the Boat, dancers can't help but have fun!
There are currently more than a dozen square dance clubs in San Diego County.
The Valley Twirlers Square Dance Club at valleytwirlers.com in El Cajon starts classes for new dancers on Tuesday, Sept. 17, from 6:30 to 8 p.m. at the air-conditioned Bostonia Rec Center, 1049 Bostonia St. The Caller/Instructor, Steve Moore, has been teaching square dancing for almost 50 years (he started when he was 14).
No experience, partner, or fancy attire needed, $5 per class, with the first class free .
For other square dance clubs offering classes, visit backcountrysda.com or call ( 619 ) 499-5379 (landline).

title: The Fire Within Sycuan Fashion Show celebrates Native Americans
description: The 2024 Sycuan Fashion Show was he
content:
The 2024 Sycuan Fashion Show was held at the Sycuan Casino and Resort on Sept. 5. This event celebrates Native American designers, models, and artists, showcasing the talents of Indigenous people across Turtle Island. The designers skillfully blended traditional craftsmanship with contemporary fashion. Now in its third year, the show took place in the Heritage Ballroom with Ruben Littlehead returning as the enthusiastic emcee. He began the event with an opening prayer accompanied by bird singers and dancers.
This year's theme, 'The Fire Within,' comes from the Kumeyaay word for 'hello' (Haawka). This is a term they ask ones they come across, 'How is their spirit?' Program director Angelica Labrake said this is a testament to the Indigenous people to never have their spirit dimmed in this fashion industry and to showcase our people who are blazing through in fashion.
The stage backdrop glowed with flames. and the runway was encircled by fire creating a breathtaking scene that wowed the audience. A door in the center of the backdrop made it appear as though the models were walking through flames as they stepped onto the runway, adding to the drama.
Em Assiniboine PHOTOS BY DIANA CAVAGNARO Indig-A-Ribbon Designs. Shining Star by Shay.
Ocean Kiana. Ally's Ribbons Collaborations. Ro Tree and Cheyleen Julian.
House of Beauty by Wabanoonkwe. Bitterwater for Redhouse. 3 Feathers Star Quilts.
This year, they had 11 designers from the U.S. and Canada including the Sycuan Education Department. Em Assiniboine Designs opened the runway with a modern interpretation of women's fashion. Indig-A-Ribbon Designs showed off matching bags with their designs, while Shining Star by Shay brought high fashion to the runway. Thunderheart Custom Wear delighted the audience with tribal prints and fringe, and Ocean Kiana presented chic casual wear, including miniskirts and corsets.
Ally's Ribbons followed using geometric designs and ribbons. Ro Tree and Cheyleen Julian were back with unique designs and color coordination while the House of Beauty by Wabanoonkwe began their segment with a ballet-inspired dancer. This chic wear had a native twist. Bitterwater for Redhouse has a sustainable focus on using sequins and ribbons in their collection. Benjamin Leedom was back again this year with the fabulous 3 Feathers Star Quilts. The finale finished with the next generation of youth showing kids wear.
After the show, guests were invited to a vendor area in the Wachena Ballroom, where they could shop and purchase all the incredible designs.
UPCOMING EVENTS

Sunday, Sept. 21 – 20th annual Strut for Sobriety! fashion show and recovery awareness event for new PATH at the Sheraton San Diego Hotel & Marina. Tickets at: 619-670-1184.
Diana Cavagnaro is an internationally renowned Couture Milliner based in the San Diego area. Learn more about our hat designer, teacher, and blogger at dianacavagnaro.com. Tags: Diana CavagnaroSycuan Fashion Show

title: Man pleads guilty to molesting 14-year-old girl on plane
description: A former Downtown man has pleaded guilty to molesting a 14-year-old girl who sat next to him on an airplane flight from North Carolina to San Diego. Ryan Bill Coffey, 33, faces up to two years in…
content:
A former Downtown man has pleaded guilty to molesting a 14-year-old girl who sat next to him on an airplane flight from North Carolina to San Diego.
Ryan Bill Coffey, 33, faces up to two years in federal prison when he is sentenced on Nov. 4 by U.S. District Court Judge Anthony Battaglia.
The incident took place on Jan. 7, 2023, when the girl was apparently traveling alone from Charlotte, N.C., and was assigned randomly to sit next to Coffey, who did not know her, according to the U.S. Attorney's office.
'Thanks to the courage of a brave girl who reported what happened in the dark on a plane and swift engagement from law enforcement, this defendant was brought to justice,' said U.S. Attorney Tara McGrath.
Coffey admitted to giving the girl rum and touching her inner thigh and breasts while seated, according to authorities.
'The U.S. Attorney's office is committed to protecting the public in the air, on the ground, or at sea,' said McGrath.
'Ryan Coffey's conduct was abhorrent,' said Acting FBI San Diego Special Agent in charge T.J. Holland.
'The FBI, along with our dedicated law enforcement partners remain committed to using all tools available to follow the evidence and bring those who commit crimes against children to justice,' said Holland.
Coffey was allowed to remain free on $50,000 bond on condition he remain in his apartment Downtown. Before he pleaded guilty to a felony on Aug. 12, he was allowed to travel to a pawn shop in Hillcrest to transfer ownership of a .45 caliber firearm as a felon cannot possess a firearm, according to court records.
Because he is ordered to remain at home, Coffey received permission from Battaglia to move to Colorado with a family member where he can live until sentencing on Nov. 4.
Though the incident occurred in 2023, Coffey was not indicted on charges until March 15, 2024. Coffey, who works in accounting, will have to register as a sex offender in whatever county he will reside in after he finishes his sentence. Tags: airportcourtscrimeplane

title: How to Be a Better Advocate for Social Justice in the Community
author: Grhics Tech
description: There are 8 separate and distinct racial demographics in New York alone, for the city's total cumulative population of more than 8 million people. 17.2% of the city's population (1,376,000) live in poverty. The New York unemployment rate is 4.90%. The city is one of the most famous in the…
content:
There are 8 separate and distinct racial demographics in New York alone, for the city's total cumulative population of more than 8 million people. 17.2% of the city's population (1,376,000) live in poverty. The New York unemployment rate is 4.90%. The city is one of the most famous in the world, its sprawling metropolitan streets littered with the glamor of the big city. But as with all things, there is a mirror to the glitz and glitter of the home of Broadway, the Statue of Liberty, the Empire State Building, Central Park, and Times Square; one of poverty, crime, and inequality.
Students of any online MSW programs in New York will understand that the only way to solve a problem is to admit that there is one. The problems facing New York aren't anything that we cannot solve, and they certainly aren't specific to New York. They are problems facing the entire world – but we can solve them. We just need to be brave enough to advocate for social justice, making our city, and maybe one day the world a better place one cause at a time.
But do you need to be a social worker to advocate for social change? We don't think so. Knowing What to Advocate For
Social advocacy can be hard to engage in because there are just so many issues, and all of them are usually dedicated to one or two particular demographics. The world is populated by 8 billion people, and there is a long and troubled history between every single nation on the globe. As a result, there are countless issues, and endless causes that need people to talk about them.
The first step in changing the world is the acquisition of knowledge. There are several major social issues, including gender inequality , the marginalization of LGBTQI+ people , racial intolerance , and many more .
The first step to advocating is to study these issues, understand their history and dynamic, and understand if you are someone suffering because of the issue, or unwittingly benefitting from/contributing to it. Once you have a solid understanding of the facts , you will then be able to formulate a stance based on your values that will allow you to better advocate for social justice. Vote, For Everything
The thing about social justice is that it demands people to speak up. There are millions of voices for every cause, but lasting change can only happen at the hands of those in power. Understanding how your nation divides its political power is crucial to an understanding of your country's engagement in human rights and social justice.
In countries such as the USA that practice democracy , the people's votes determine the political leader of the nation, and that leader should live up to the views of the political party they represent thereby representing the desires of the people who voted for them. Voting is the most important thing that people can do to effect change.
Keep Up With News
There is a plethora of news media, and with the freedom of the internet, it's entirely plausible to examine the news sources of the entire world, allowing you to gain global perspectives on various issues and remain informed about the causes you follow.
However, the nature of journalism nowadays means that consumers have to have a degree of critical thought. The nature of the internet has opened up avenues for conspiracists and the delusional to spread their falsehoods and misinformation . Fortunately, there are many fact checking websites out there and the sheer amount of resources on the net allows consumers to compare sources and confirm the validity of what they hear.
Despite this, there is still a shocking prevalence of people who still refuse to do their due diligence, even with the most out-there conspiracies. It is important that when pursuing social justice, you listen to experts rather than the grapevine – and validate any claims you hear. Ensure This Isn't About You
There is a plague in the social justice community of people taking on causes for clout, fame, sympathy or praise. It is normal to feel good when doing good things, there is nothing wrong with that. When it becomes wrong, people latch onto issues that truly mean nothing to them.
For example the phenomenon of 'queerbaiting,' the practise of celebrities or companies hinting at or skirting around LGBTQI+ identities, without actually committing or saying outright whether they are or not. This allows them to access the LGBTQI+ audience, and increase their exposure, or manipulate their publicity favourably.
Advocating for social issues is a great way to help improve your community and to make the lives of marginalized communities easier and less drought, and it also brings a true sense of fulfillment .
Be Prepared To Stand Up
When you start advocating for social justice, you are going to eventually run into people who think you're misguided. You'll be called names, you'll be insulted, and you'll be told that you're mistaken. But standing for social justice has never been easy. Every major social shift towards progress and the advancement of society came because a person or people stood against something that was unjust or cruel.
It has been the people who take the brave stance of standing against the status quo to force the world to face modernity. Some people can't handle that. They think that the way things are is the way things should be, and the way things always should be. They believe that progress and the development of society ruin their world and weaken their culture. However, this means that they also think that the world is better when certain people suffer.
Whatever you choose to stand for, you will eventually be faced with backlash about it. If you decide to use your voice to demand social justice for those living without it, be prepared to use it to also defend yourself.

title: The Lot redesigns outdoor dining space and adds refreshed menu
author: Dave
description: The Lot in downtown La Jolla, a new dimension in modern-era movie viewing, has gone one step further in
content:
The Lot in downtown La Jolla, a new dimension in modern-era movie viewing, has gone one step further in re-branding its expansive outdoor dining facilities.
Now renamed Zentrl Kitchen + Bar, the theme of the re-imagined outdoor dining space is 'modern meets elegance.' The thoughtfully redesigned space features marble tables, wooden accents, warm woods, and inspiring artwork creating an ambiance perfect for enjoying delicious food and great company.
Zentrl's menu now features fresh ingredients and innovative flavors, serving everything from crisp salads to juicy burgers and signature sushi rolls. There is also an all-new craft cocktail menu. The kitchen is now open for breakfast, lunch, and dinner, which is served from 5 p.m. to close.
'This is the family's third iteration of the (dine-in theater) space,' said Lot revenue manager Daniel Fastlicht, son of founder Adolfo Fastlicht, a Harvard graduate whose thesis involved U.S. movie multiplexes. 'He (Adolfo) was living in Mexico City at the time, which still had only the large, one-plex concept,' said Daniel Fastlicht, noting Adolfo thought it was 'ludicrous for them not to have evolved into the modern age of cinema, which was the multiplexes.'
Fastlicht said his dad brought something new and innovative into moviegoing. 'It was more into the experience, specifically food and beverage,' he said. 'As it (moviegoing) evolved throughout the years, we noticed that the experience around the content is why we have a lot of engagement with our moviegoers.'
Daniel Fastlicht noted there are cross-currents now within the transforming movie industry worldwide. 'The theater industry worldwide is shrinking, but our (The Lot's dine-in) percentage of that pie is growing,' he said. 'We've seen a growing attendance. People have said, 'Movie theaters are dying.' Our spin on that is that traditional movie theaters are dying.'
Explaining The Lot's new approach, Fastlicht noted: 'The main concept behind our company initially was to be an entertainment venue. 'The idea of that was to be a place that could be the heart of the community. We wanted the community to use us as their playground, whether it was to host an event, come and watch a football game, or have a date night for a film. We could allow them (patrons) to pick their adventure.'
All of The Lots allow patrons to watch their favorite movies from the comfort of oversized, reclinable leather seats and order food and drinks with the touch of a button.
Daniel Fastlicht noted The Lot's restaurant re-brand complemented the new concept of the theater experience being more than just a movie. 'The reason why we re-branded our restaurant here is we felt that, over the years, the community started to identify us only as a movie theater, and we wanted to change that perception,' he said. 'So we added the brand of Zentrl.'
Zentrl seems like an unusual name for a theater. 'It's a play on central in Spanish, with us being from Mexico City,' noted Fastlicht adding, 'When we were coming up with different names, we came up with this concept that's central, the heart.'
The new far-ranging Zentrl menu includes breakfast sandwiches, avocado toast, acai bowls, Eggs Benedict, coconut shrimp, fried calamari, flatbreads, burgers, Atlantic salmon, vegetable ravioli, and braised beef short ribs. The menu also features numerous soups, salads, and bowls, as well as tasty desserts like lava cake, seasonal bread pudding, and lemon cheesecake.
Regarding Zentrl's menu refresh, Fastlicht pointed out that food and drinks are 'something that brings people together. So we wanted [the restaurant] to be a focal point for a new experience. And part of this new re-brand is we're leaning a little bit more into Asian-Mediterranean fusion while keeping some of our Hispanic inspiration in some of the dishes and the drinks. That gives us this unique positioning of giving people what they want.'
ZENTRL KITCHEN + BAR
Where: 7611 Fay Ave.
Info: zentrlkitchen.com, 858-222-9792.
Multiplex theaters – On July 12, 1963, Stanley H. Durwood opened what is widely believed to be the first movie theater designed specifically as a twin multiplex in Kansas City, Mo. Durwood's Parkway Theatres set a trend that eventually dominated America's movie house industry.
During the 1980s and 1990s, AMC Theatres was at the forefront of a massive boom in multiplex and megaplex construction across the United States. From 1988 to 2000, the number of U.S., movie screens exploded from roughly 23,000 to 37,000. By the end of 1997, the United States was home to 149 megaplexes with over 2,800 screens. In some areas, megaplexes became not just another option for moviegoers, but soon the only one, having driven all other theaters out of business. From 1995 to 2004, the total number of theaters in the United States fell from 7,151 to 5,629.

title: San Diego FC announces Mikey Varas as head coach
description: After several months of speculation, which included names like Hugo Sanchez, Landon Donovan, and Javier Aguirre among several others, San Diego FC announced M
content:
After several months of speculation, which included names like Hugo Sanchez, Landon Donovan, and Javier Aguirre among several others, San Diego FC announced Mikey Varas as its head coach.
Varas most recently served as the interim head coach of the U.S. men's national team after leading the
U-20 side at the 2022 Concacaf championship where the team won the tournament.
'I am honored to join San Diego FC as the club's first head coach,' said Varas. 'The opportunity to build something special from the ground up, with such ambitious and committed ownership, and in a city with such a passionate fan base, is truly exciting.'
At the 2022 FIFA World Cup, Varas served as an opponent scout and later coached the U-20 side to the top of their group at the 2023 FIFA U-20 World Cup in Argentina.
'We believe Mikey (Varas) is the perfect choice to lead San Diego FC as the club's first head coach,' said SDFC chairman, Sir Mohamed Mansour. 'As we prepare for our inaugural season, Mikey's leadership, desire to win now, and his deep understanding of player development make him the ideal choice to guide our club forward.'
Before joining U.S. Soccer, Varas served as an assistant coach for FC Dallas under former head coach Luchi Gonzalez for three seasons. During his tenure, FC Dallas reached the MLS Cup playoffs twice fueled by several standout homegrown players from the club's academy.
'I look forward to working with the team and the community to develop a winning culture from the start. I will give everything to this club and the people of San Diego,' Varas added.
San Diego FC has already made several noteworthy player signings in preparation for its inaugural Major League Soccer season including former San Diego Loyal goalkeeper Duran Ferree, former Manchester United defender Patrick McNair, along with the team's first two international signings Marcus Ingvartsen and Jeppe Tverskov, from FC Nordsjaelland in the Danish Superliga. SDFC also recently announced it had acquired Alex Mighten from English Premier League side Nottingham Forest F.C. signing the winger to a two-and-a-half-year contract through the end of the 2026 season with a club option for an additional year.
'Mikey embodies the values and ambitions of San Diego FC,' said SDFC sporting director Tyler Heaps. 'His ideas on the game and how it should be played align with ours and his commitment and energy throughout the process is one that we feel connects with this community and our vision for the club.' Tags: Mikey VarasSan Diego FC

title: The Boardwalk Hotel is Mission Beach's newest boutique property
description: Sun, sand, and sophisticated style collide at The Boardwalk Hotel, Mission Beach's newest boutique escape, which recently announced its soft opening under the experienced management of Brick Hospitality.
content:
Sun, sand, and sophisticated style collide at The Boardwalk Hotel, Mission Beach's newest boutique escape, which recently announced its soft opening under the experienced management of Brick Hospitality.
Formerly known as the Santa Clara Motel, The Boardwalk Hotel is steps from the sands of Mission Beach and the tranquility of Mission Bay, promising an unforgettable experience on San Diego's coastline.
'We are excited to introduce The Boardwalk Hotel as the new hospitality experience in Mission Beach,' said Daniel Kalenov, co-developer of The Boardwalk Hotel. 'Our goal was to create a space that captures the essence of coastal living while providing unparalleled comfort and style.'
Kalenov added: 'Mission Beach has been an iconic destination in San Diego for over a century, but it's never had an iconic place to stay. Now it does.'
The 18 uniquely appointed rooms create an intimate atmosphere, each boasting a 'boutique beach' experience. Guests can choose from stylish boho bungalows or lavish two-bedroom suites with ocean views and private rooftop decks. The hotel prioritizes relaxation and rejuvenation, whether it's soaking in a personal hot tub on a private patio or unwinding in a spa-inspired bathroom.
Thoughtful, functional design sets the hotel apart with smart TVs, high-speed Wi-Fi, and stylish kitchenettes, all wrapped in a coastal-inspired aesthetic. The hotel's crown jewel, a large common area patio with fire pits, seating, and shade, allows guests to soak up the sun with people-watching opportunities.
Situated between the Pacific Ocean and Mission Bay, the hotel offers access to a coastal playground. Explore the thrills of Belmont Park's Giant Dipper roller coaster, try watersports like surfing or paddleboarding, or stroll along the sandy shores. A vibrant nightlife and diverse dining options ensure something for everyone, all within walking distance.
The hotel caters to more than just solo travelers. Group reservations are welcome, making it a location for weddings, corporate retreats, or family reunions.
As part of its phase two of opening, the hotel announced plans for a new, privately-owned 'Baja cantina-style' restaurant slated for late 2024. This addition will give guests more opportunities to savor the coastal cuisines located within the property.
For more information or to make a reservation, visit hotelboardwalk.com or email [email protected]. Follow on Instagram @theboardwalkhotel for the latest updates.

title: The Lodge at Torrey Pines announces A.R. Valentien restaurant renovations
description: The Lodge at Torrey Pines, Evans Hotels' distinguished AAA Five Diamond resort in La Jolla, announced a major renovation of A.R. Valentien – the Lodge's signature fine dining restaurant – this fall. A.R. Valentien will be temporarily closed as the kitchen is renovated with an expansion and comprehensive rebuild of…
content:
The Lodge at Torrey Pines, Evans Hotels' distinguished AAA Five Diamond resort in La Jolla, announced a major renovation of A.R. Valentien – the Lodge's signature fine dining restaurant – this fall. A.R. Valentien will be temporarily closed as the kitchen is renovated with an expansion and comprehensive rebuild of the kitchen line.
'As one of Southern California's top luxury hotels, we're dedicated to making resort enhancements and upholding our tradition of culinary excellence,' said Kelli Crosson, The Lodge's executive chef. 'The updated and enhanced kitchen will ensure an exceptional dining experience for our guests.'
The A.R. Valentien project will introduce a new pastry kitchen, a modern new butchery section, upgraded flooring, walls, and lighting, along with an enhanced HVAC system, all aimed at creating an expanded and modernized kitchen that will continue to elevate the customer's culinary experience at The Lodge well into the future.
